pillars.text: TEL is no. 1 or no. 2 in all markets they compete (mostly with Applied Materials and Lam Research). Strong customer relationships and tight integration within the semiconductor ecosystem built on mutual trust around leading-edge technologies, backed by nearly 25,000 patents, help them sustain their market-leading positions. TEL’s massive scale advantages result from product development spend that is unmatched by most (high-single-digits to low-double-digits as a percent of total sales), and they continue to invest heavily through the cycle regardless of short-term headwinds. In 2024, they committed to investing ¥1.5tn (nearly $10bn USD) in R&D over a 5-year period through fiscal 2029. Per management, while the WFE investment environment can change by the day, “technology innovation never stops”.
